selection: 池 621（627 − W2 6）。依 R-VS58 自池首取 10；P0→P1→P2，同序內逐 Test Set 輪流 ＋ reqid 升冪。本批 10 條皆為 P0（R-VF57，P0 = 88）。
signal_notation: R-1 v2：PROXI $Param$ = "值"；Input Test Data 為 NA
design_method_domain: SWC 0708 交付本之 `下拉選單` 分頁，9 值
seq_basis: R-VF1（VF230 線）：B 欄自 238 起；本批為 238–247。**本輪不寫回**（R-VF26），`seq` 僅記於產出。
spec_reference_form: `VF230_V1-{n}`，其 n 取自 037 之 `Source Requirement ID`（`SYS-RA-VF230_V1-{n}`）。**此形式係依 Part 1 之 `CFTS044-{7位 reqid}` 推得（去 `SYS-RA-` 前綴），**非條文所定，待確認**。
delegation: 627 全數 `no`（W-VF46／W-VF50），本批無畫面層委派。

tcs.tc_title: Power Tailgate Alert is not displayed when CAN node 82 (PTGM) is absent
tcs.test_item:
When the HMI receives the value Absent via signal, $CAN_Node_82_PTGM$, Then the HMI shall not display the Power Tailgate Alert customer setting in the Vehicle Settings menu.

(Configuration-absent partition; distinguishes the not-displayed case from the Power Tailgate setting of the same node)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The vehicle is powered and the HU has completed start-up
2. The Vehicle Settings menu is reachable from the home screen
tcs.test_procedure:
1. PROXI $CAN_Node_82_PTGM$ = "Absent"
2. Power cycle the HU and wait until the Vehicle Settings menu is fully rendered
3. Read the Vehicle Settings menu and check that the Power Tailgate Alert customer setting is not listed
tcs.expected_result:
1. PROXI $CAN_Node_82_PTGM$ reads "Absent"
2. The Vehicle Settings menu is displayed
3. The Power Tailgate Alert customer setting is not displayed in the Vehicle Settings menu
tcs.reasoning: P0(c) safety (R-VF57)：Power Tailgate Alert 之設定項決定試驗者能否開關該警示；其不顯示即駕駛無從調整。值域來源：**條文自帶值** `[Absent]`（R-VF13 鏈序之前，非 LID／DBC／PROXI／VC-VM）。
